results.name: browser and CommonJS expose the same API
web mode sells nothing and owns nothing, even with a forged cache
native without store keys stays unconfigured and sells nothing
native configures once with the platform key and loads prices from the store
native purchase grants the entitlement and persists the first-paint cache
unbuilt and unknown products cannot be purchased
user cancel and store errors are reported without granting anything
a second tap during a purchase is rejected, not double-charged
a refund is honored: the store answer replaces the cache on next launch
offline launch keeps the last known entitlements
blocked storage and throwing listeners never break a purchase
mock mode simulates purchase, cancel, failure, persistence and reset
the real store never exposes the mock controls outside mock mode
